title: Small Hours FM
tagline: Six invented night stations hiding in the static.
how_to: Tap Switch on (sound on), then drag the dial left and right to tune in stations.
description: A night radio with a glowing tuning dial. Between the hiss and heterodyne whistles hide six synthesized stations: a music-box lullaby, a numbers broadcast, brush jazz, a weather report for nobody, a lighthouse theremin and a station of dead air. Station names un-garble as you tune closer; find all six.
spark: Taken literally: the whole thing is a radio, with tuning, static and drifting signals.
proud_of: Every station plays live all at once and the dial just crossfades them, so tuning feels like a real signal swelling out of the noise.
